The hostsThree friends, one group chat, way too many opinions about the offside rule.

"We started BallHerTalk because we were tired of being the only woman in the room who actually watched the match."

BallHerTalk began as a group chat that got too big for group chat energy. What started as post-match voice notes turned into a full podcast — part tactics breakdown, part girls' night, all football.

Every week we cover the matches, the transfer window chaos, and the culture around the game — plus the conversations that never make it onto the panel shows. No mansplaining the offside rule required.

— The BallHerTalk hosts
